subject: Hall of Fame fixed!
author: Xandu
body:
Thank you for reporting this bug. It seems like the Hall of Fame stopped showing correctly almost a year ago when the site was upgraded to the latest version of PHP and MYSQL. I have now fixed all the leaderboards and increased the number of entries from 15 to 50 pr. leaderboard.

As no scores have been added for quite some time we have decided to close the Hall of Fame. This means that no new entries can be added and the existing entries are locked.

If someone wants to update their entries pm me with the relevant data and I will fix it for you. New entries will not be accepted.

-- The Creator --
